title: An invoiced work order with an inactive part can be viewed, printed and reported
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, with Sell Price $20.00.
  • Create a work order, work order 1, for this test, that sold 1 of part A today on its line, line 1, and is invoiced.
  • Set part A inactive after the invoice was made.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Finance tab.
  2. Click the print icon on the Finance tab.
  3. Close the print preview.
  4. Click Reports in the top bar.
  5. Click Parts Velocity.
  6. Set the date range to today.
  7. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1's invoice shows part A, 1 × $20.00, and line 1 still shows part A on the Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The print preview opens and lists part A.

Step 3:

  • The preview closes.

Step 4:

  • The Reports page opens.

Step 5:

  • The Parts Velocity report opens.

Step 6:

  • The report covers today.

Step 7:

  • Part A is listed with a sold quantity of 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-E4: “Completed and invoiced work orders that hold an inactive part stay viewable, printable and reportable.”
  • S9-E11: “Reports keep inactive parts. Inventory Value and Parts Velocity include them, because their stock still has value and their history still happened.”
